capabilities: play detected progressions with a sampled piano or synth
resolve numeric and Roman-numeral degrees against a configured key root
limit detection to selected vault folders
disambiguation: Not a music file player or audio embed tool; it detects chord notation in note text and synthesizes the progression.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Supported chord syntax covers extensions, altered, sus/add, diminished, and slash chords; inline code is scanned while fenced code blocks are ignored.
problem: Obsidian has no way to recognize chord progressions written in notes or to hear them played back while studying or writing music.
summary: Chord-progression detector that finds harmonic progressions in notes and plays them with a bundled sampled piano or synth.
